blurb: Guests can book guided trail rides ranging from 15 minutes to full day exploring mountain trails and scenic lakes. Pack trips offer riding and gear transport to backcountry destinations with permit reservations included. Resupply services deliver gear and food to hikers on trail with various drop points and durations. Full day fishing trips include guided rides and pack animals for gear.
